notes: No accepted C++ was collected (three WA, two RTE), so orig.cpp is the official CEOI 2022 solution (the accepted submission in the CEOI 2022 Kattis package). Any non-crossing drawing is accepted, so checker.py checks the permutation and runs a Shamos-Hoey sweep for crossing edges. On 300 random cases (reference output, the same with two labels swapped, a random permutation) it agreed with an independent all-pairs segment test every time, and the reference passed on every case, the samples and --max.
